metric_definitions.user_turns: count of user messages required to initiate the scenario
metric_definitions.manual_governance_directives: count of workbench lifecycle tools the benchmark prompt must explicitly choreograph
metric_definitions.workbench_tool_calls: count of public workbench tool calls actually made by the parent
metric_definitions.time_to_first_effective_write_ms: worker-path mtime after the first successful edit minus the parent user-message timestamp; null when no write is expected
metric_definitions.wall_ms: parent user-message timestamp to final assistant-message timestamp, or persisted invocation wall time
metric_definitions.full_validation_runs: full repository check runs caused by the product scenario
metric_definitions.authority_identity_bytes_read: journal before/after bytes plus ChangeSet finalization bytes plus persisted review relevance file-identity bytes; excludes Git process internals
metric_definitions.durable_file_delta: new product-governance files observed for the scenario; historical bundle values marked authority_only exclude receipts and telemetry
metric_definitions.durable_byte_delta: bytes written to new or appended product-governance records under the same measurement boundary
metric_definitions.index_lines: physical line count of extensions/workbench-runtime/index.ts at S2.0

scenarios.fixture: one synthetic tracked file, one successful edit, complete review
two synthetic tracked files, two sequential successful edits, complete review
one synthetic tracked file changed by the worker and a concurrent sidecar
one status query against an already reviewed synthetic delegation

scenarios.persistence_measurement: two receipt files plus two telemetry JSONL appends
